## Walkthrough The PR updates Go, OpenShift, Kubernetes, gRPC, and build toolchain versions, aligns Kubernetes replacement pins, and adds error handling for quota configuration creation in two controller entry points. ### Changes **Dependency and controller updates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Update toolchain and module pins**
`.ci-operator.yaml`, `Dockerfile.rhel`, `go.mod`|Go, OpenShift, Kubernetes, gRPC, protobuf, middleware, replacement pins, and builder images are updated.| |**Propagate quota configuration errors**
`pkg/cmd/controller/quota.go`|Both quota controller entry points now return errors from quota configuration construction before using the configuration.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Suggested reviewers:** `ingvagabund`, `kaleemsiddiqu`

the PR only changes controller/build/dependency files, so MicroShift-specific test compatibility isn't implicated. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No _test.go or Ginkgo e2e test declarations were added or modified in this PR; changes are limited to controller code, vendoring, and build config. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | quota.go only adds error handling; go.mod/Docker/CI bumps change build inputs only and introduce no node selectors, affinities, spreads, or replica logic. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | PR changes only build config and quota controller error handling; no stdout writes were added in process-level code. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo e2e tests were added; the PR only updates deps/build files and controller error handling, with no IPv4 or external-connectivity assumptions. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | No new weak-crypto usage was introduced; the new cert code uses stdlib/sha256, and RC4/3DES cipher mappings were already present in the base version. | | Container-Privileges | ✅ Passed | No changed manifest or pod spec adds privileged settings; the only match was a generated API doc string, not a runtime config. | | No-Sensitive-Data-In-Logs | ✅ Passed | Touched changes only bump deps/images and add error handling; quota.go has no logging calls or sensitive terms, so no sensitive data appears in logs. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title clearly matches the main change: bumping Kubernetes/OpenShift dependencies to v1.36.2. |
